title: ClassificationLinear Predict
text: Classify observations using linear classification model, 1 input, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Score data type} sets Data type of score output Inherit:; {Select trained machine learning model} sets the linear classification model, {Add output port for predicted class scores} adds second output port for predicted class, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Label data type} sets the data type of label output, {Label data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of label output for range checking, {Label data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of label output for range checking, {Score data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of score output for range checking, {Score data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of score output for range checking, {Raw score data type} sets the untransformed score data type Inherit, {Raw score data type Minimum} sets the minimum untransformed score for range checking, {Raw score data type Maximum} sets the maximum untransformed score for range checking, {Inner product data type}, {Inner product data type Minimum} sets the minimum of inner product term for range checking and {Inner product data type Maximum} sets the maximum of inner product term for range checking. Values come from the instance.
